hero.title: Build Difficulty Guide
hero.subtitle: Find the perfect project that matches your skill level and experience.

intro.title: Understanding Difficulty Levels
intro.description: We categorize our products into four difficulty levels to help you choose the right project. Each level indicates the required skills, time investment, and tools needed.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.description: Perfect for those new to 3D printing or RC modeling. These projects have fewer parts, simpler assembly, and basic electronics wiring.
beginner.skills: Basic 3D printing knowledge, no RC experience required
beginner.tools: Basic tool set - screwdrivers, pliers, tweezers
beginner.bestFor: Absolute beginners, students, gifts for RC enthusiasts

intermediate.name: Intermediate
intermediate.description: For builders with some 3D printing experience and basic electronics knowledge. Moderately complex assembly with more parts and simple calibration.
intermediate.tools: Tool set + soldering iron, multimeter, calipers
intermediate.bestFor: Hobby enthusiasts ready for a challenge, 3D printer owners

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.tagline: For those who want a real challenge
advanced.description: Complex projects with many components, advanced electronics, and precision assembly. Requires patience, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
advanced.skills: 1+ year 3D printing experience, advanced soldering, Arduino programming
advanced.tools: Professional tool set, oscilloscope, calibration equipment
advanced.examples: ENDEAVOUR RC APC (500+ parts, Arduino Mega control)

expert.name: Expert
expert.description: The most challenging projects with thousands of parts, custom PCBs, and advanced mechanical systems. Only for the most experienced builders.
expert.time: 150+ hours total (100+ h printing, 50+ h assembly)
expert.skills: Multi-year experience, PCB design, advanced programming, mechanical engineering
expert.tools: Complete workshop, advanced measurement tools, programming equipment

philosophy.title: Our "No Glue" Philosophy
philosophy.intro: Every Martyx Industries model is engineered without the need for glue.
philosophy.benefit1Text: Take apart and reassemble anytime for maintenance or modifications.
philosophy.benefit2Text: Learn how every component fits together and understand the mechanics.
philosophy.benefit3Text: Precision-engineered screw connections provide better structural integrity.
philosophy.benefit4Text: Clean building experience without sticky residue or drying times.
